bottomContentText: In this service, you choose a mentor with whom you would like to talk. Once you have registered and logged in to the service, you can freely browse mentor profiles. Below are fictional mentor profiles.
cardText: Support from volunteer mentors. Send a message and start a conversation!
finalContainerHeader: Ylitse - Peer Support for Young People and Adults
finalContainerText: Start using Ylitse by registering for the service or logging in to continue using it as usual. Either way, we wish you enriching conversations!
mentorCardSkills: I Can Also Help With These
middleInfo1Text: In the free Ylitse service, volunteers trained by SOS Children's Village provide confidential support to individuals aged 17 and over — you can receive support regardless of time and place. A peer mentor can be your conversation partner, guide, empathetic listener, or coach in various life situations.
middleInfo2Heading: What Can I Talk About With a Mentor?
middleInfo2Text: You can talk with peer mentors about anything that is troubling you as often as you like. Together you decide when to have converstaions.
middleInfo3Heading: Can I Use the Service Anonymously?
middleInfo3Text: You can use the application anonymously. Just choose a nickname that does not reveal your identity. Conversations with mentors are confidential.
middleInfoFooter: Start using the service by registering
mobileAppAdText: You can use the Ylitse service in a way that suits you best, whether on your phone or computer. You can find Ylitse in the app stores for Android and iOS devices.
ylitseClosing1: Ylitse peer mentoring in its current form will end at the end of 2026. Users who logged in to the service before November 2026 can discuss the possibility of staying in contact with their own mentor. SOS Children’s Villages Finland will guide volunteer mentors on the practical arrangements.
ylitseClosing2: People with experience of child welfare services can seek peer support through the Nuorten Turvasatama community. Through OLKA, people can also find peer support for a wide variety of life situations.
ylitseClosing3: SOS Children’s Villages Finland provided Ylitse peer mentoring with funding from STEA for ten years. During that time, more than 5,000 peer-support conversations took place on Ylitse MentorApp. Our warmest thanks to all the peer mentors who participated!
